# md-knowledge-graph

> Build an INDEX.md and a JSON graph from Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter and wiki links, reporting broken links and orphans. Python package `trysac-md-knowledge-graph`, import name `md_knowledge_graph`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, runtime dependency PyYAML >= 6.0, < 7.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and data flow
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests and what they must cover
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits

## Optional
